fullContentHtml:
BSEB Bihar D.El.Ed Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar School Examination Board, Patna (BSEB) has released the answer key for the BSEB Bihar D.El.Ed, Examination for Admission In Diploma In Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) For Two Years Course Program For Session 2026-28. Applications for the BSEB Bihar D.El.Ed Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 11 December 2025, to 24 January 2026. The written examination is was held on 08-22 June 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their BSEB Bihar D.El.Ed Answer Key 2026-28 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 11 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 11 December 2025
  • Last Date : 24 January 2026 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 January 2026
  • 1st Dummy Admit Card Available : 28 January 2026
  • 1st Dummy Admit Card Correction : 28 January to 02 February 2026
  • 2nd Dummy Admit Card Available : 05 February 2026
  • 2nd Dummy Admit Card Correction : 05-10 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 08-22 January 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 28 May 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 02 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, BC, EBC : Rs. 960/-
  • SC, ST, Divyang : Rs. 760/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
